title: Git-object reachability for pinned C77 capsule sources
source_freeze: Caller must obtain source HEAD through actually callable GitHub API, not through an untrusted model-provided payload

source_proof.raw_commit: Git raw commit bytes including tree SHA and original SHA-1 identity

source_proof.derived_c71: Source C71 blob anchored; derivation itself NOT independently attested by reachability
source_proof.generated_cx_proof: Qualified build artifact with no Git source blob; never promoted to original Git source

repo_DoD: Real git cat-file commit/tree bytes from PR checkout, not synthetic Git object text

C77 derived artifacts remain explicitly unqualified for original blob reachability

Node20 Node22 plus C77/C78/C79/C80 regressions and root check green
Machine-readable proof generated and verified by a separate CLI, with bounded file sizes
No private keys, host-source or canonical authority invented
host_DoD: Source HEAD independently obtained from callable GitHub ref API before host source proof
Commit and tree object bytes physically transferred after EXPERIMENTAL selection
Actual host tool readbacks match proof bytes and source SHA
Actual C78 Node result on current human input

limitations: Git SHA-1 object identity and reachability are byte-consistency checks, not GitHub API origin
